name: td-reviewer-sol
description: Independent code reviewer running on gpt-5.6-sol. One of two parallel reviewers for cross-model review. Reviews a change against the ordered lenses (logic/security/tests, plus conditional API/rollback/perf), grades findings P0-P3, and returns a [Pn] file:line list. Invoked by /td-review-cross; not meant to be called alone.
